$comment: DRAFT manifest for the .mcpb MCP Bundle (Claude Desktop Extension). Validate with `mcpb validate` before packing; field set follows github.com/modelcontextprotocol/mcpb as of 2026-06. Do not publish before the repo is public (approval gate).
name: servomotor-mcp
description: Drive Gearotons M17 open-source servomotors from plain English over RS-485 — discovers your serial ports, auto-detects the motors on the bus, and exposes the firmware's full command set.
long_description: The M17 is an open-source, closed-loop NEMA-17 integrated servomotor (motor + driver + controller + encoder in one, daisy-chainable over RS-485). This server lets Claude discover the serial adapters on your machine, auto-detect every motor on the bus (unique ID + alias, nothing hardcoded), and run any command the firmware supports — one MCP tool is generated per command in the servomotor library's catalog (48 as of library 0.10.0), plus high-level move tools with completion waits. Verified on production motors with full multi-turn range; the motor's firmware self-protects against over-current/voltage/temperature. A mock backend lets you try everything with no hardware attached.

backend.title: Backend
backend.description: 'auto' picks the real serial backend when the servomotor library is installed (mock otherwise); or force 'serial' / 'mock'.

serial_port.title: Default serial port (optional)
serial_port.description: Optional default for the connect tool (e.g. /dev/cu.usbserial-210 on macOS, COM3 on Windows). Normally leave empty — Claude discovers ports with list_serial_ports.

tools.name: list_serial_ports
tools.description: Enumerate the machine's serial ports with USB metadata

tools.name: connect
tools.description: Open a serial port and auto-detect the motors on that RS-485 bus

tools.name: detect_devices
tools.description: Re-scan the bus for motors (reboots the motors on it)

tools.name: move_to
tools.description: Move a motor to an absolute angle (degrees) and wait for completion

tools.name: move_relative
tools.description: Move a motor by a relative angle and wait for completion

tools.name: get_motor_status
tools.description: One motor's snapshot with fatal errors decoded to plain English

tools.name: run_sequence
tools.description: Run a list of move/wait/raw-command steps as one sequence

tools.name: …full firmware command set
tools.description: One tool per command in the servomotor library catalog (48 as of 0.10.0): enable/disable MOSFETs, go_to_position, velocity/acceleration moves, multimove, homing, zeroing, telemetry, PID and current settings, resets, and more
